normalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 visible terminal-cell rows after ANSI-control removal and outer-whitespace trimming. Every row also pins exact raw projected and rendered hashes plus one-based inclusive blank-column ranges.
policy: Fail-closed review of every post-Batch-53 text-bearing row immediately neighboring an accepted row. Accept only exact disposable spans proven by full-payload and aligned import-preimage evidence; retain functional copy, identity, attribution, dedication, authored dialogue or narrative, source-significant context, structural lettering, and ambiguity.
